                        ANNUAL

CORPORATE   China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited (the “Company”;
            stock code: 2319) and its subsidiaries (collectively the
 PROFILE    “Group” or “Mengniu”) mainly manufacture and distribute

 公司簡介       quality dairy products in China. It is one of the leading dairy
            product manufacturers in China, with MENGNIU as its core
            brand. Mengniu offers diversified products including liquid
            milk products, ice cream, milk formula and cheese. Mengniu
            ranked as “Global Dairy Top 10” in 2021, and placed 31th
            on BrandZ™’s list of most valuable Chinese brands, TOP10
            of brand contribution in 2020. Mengniu also made it again
            among Brand Finance’s list of the top 500 most valuable
            brands of the world in 2020. As at the end of 2021, the
            Group’s annual dairy production capacity reached 11.66
            million tons. In March 2014, Mengniu became a Hang Seng
            Index constituent, making it the first blue chip Chinese dairy
            product manufacturer. In March 2022, Mengniu was included
            as a constituent of HSI ESG Enhanced Index and HSI ESG
            Enhanced Select Index.

            中國蒙牛乳業有限公司（「本公司」；股份代號：2319）及其子
            公司（統稱「本集團」或「蒙牛」）主要於中國生產及銷售優質乳
            製品。憑藉其主要品牌蒙牛 ，蒙牛已成為中國領先的乳製品
            生產商之一。蒙牛提供多元化的產品，包括液態奶、冰淇淋、
            奶粉及奶酪產品。二零二一年，蒙牛位列「全球乳業十強」；
            蒙牛亦於二零二零年入選BrandZ™最具價值中國品牌榜第31
            位、躋身品牌貢獻TOP10排行榜，並繼續位列Brand Finance
            的全球最具價值品牌500強。截至二零二一年底，本集團乳製
            品的年生產能力達1,166萬噸。二零一四年三月，蒙牛獲納入
            恒生指數成份股，成為首家中國乳製品企業藍籌股，並於二
            零二二年三月入選恒指ESG增強指數和恒指ESG增強精選指
            數。

                                                                                         CEO’S STATEMENT
                                                                                                   總裁致辭




2021 was a noteworthy year as we commenced our five-year                二零二一年是「再創一個新蒙牛」五年戰略的開局
strategic plan of “Creating a new Mengniu”. The prolonged               之年，對我們來說意義重大。一年來，新冠肺炎
COVID-19 epidemic continued to impact the global economy                疫情持續對全球帶來影響，但得益於中國疫情防
throughout the year, but Mengniu delivered remarkable results and       控得力，相關行業政策支持及蒙牛全體員工的努
achieved overall revenue growth of 15.9%. The strong results            力，蒙牛仍然收穫了不菲的成績，整體收入增長
were attributable to a combination of effective epidemic control in     達15.9%，各個事業部也取得了傲人的發展，彰
China, policy support for the industry, and the collective efforts of   顯了集團穩健發展的態勢，為達成五年戰略目標

     and green low-carbon development by the national requirements           國乳業產業園戰略合作項目落地，聚焦黃河、嫩
     of dairy industry revitalization and optimization of milk source        江、西遼河流域產業集群佈局，未來五年實現「百

THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL
STATEMENTS
The directors of the Company are responsible for the preparation       貴公司董事遵照國際會計準則理事會頒佈的國際
of the consolidated financial statements that give a true and fair     財務報告準則及香港公司條例的披露規定編製真

disclosure requirements of the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance,          為就編製不存在由於欺詐或錯誤而導致的重大錯
and for such internal control as the directors determine is            誤陳述的綜合財務報表而言屬必要的內部監控。
necessary to enable the preparation of consolidated financial
statements that are free from material misstatement, whether due
to fraud or error.

In preparing the consolidated financial statements, the directors of   編製綜合財務報表時， 貴公司董事負責評估 貴
the Company are responsible for assessing the Group’s ability to       集團持續經營的能力，並在適用情況下披露與持
continue as a going concern, disclosing, as applicable, matters        續經營有關的事項，以及使用持續經營為會計基
related to going concern and using the going concern basis of          礎，除非 貴公司董事有意將 貴集團清盤或停
accounting unless the directors of the Company either intend to        止經營，或別無其他實際的替代方案。

      2.4 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT                                            2.4 重大會計政策概要
          ACCOUNTING POLICIES
           Investments in associates and joint ventures                       投資聯營公司及合營企業
           An associate is an entity in which the Group has a long            聯營公司指本集團持有其一般不少於20%
           term interest of generally not less than 20% of the equity         投票權的長期權益而對其有重要影響力的
           voting rights and over which it is in a position to exercise       公司。重大影響力為可參與被投資對象的
           significant influence. Significant influence is the power to       財政及營運政策決定而非對該等政策施加
           participate in the financial and operating policy decisions of     控制或共同控制。
           the investee, but is not control or joint control over those
           policies.

           A joint venture is a type of joint arrangement whereby the         合營企業屬共同安排，據此，擁有該安排共
           parties that have joint control of the arrangement have rights     同控制權的訂約方有權享有合營企業的資

           Fair value measurement                                                公允值計量
           The Group measures its share options, certain financial               於各報告期末，本集團按公允值計量其購
           assets, derivative financial instruments and certain other            股權、若干金融資產、衍生金融工具及若干
           borrowings at fair value at the end of each reporting period.         其他借貸。公允值為於計量日市場參與者
           Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an             於有秩序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負
           asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction       債須支付的價格。公允值計量乃基於假設
           between market participants at the measurement date. The              出售資產或轉移負債的交易於資產或負債
           fair value measurement is based on the presumption that               的主要市場或於未有主要市場的情況下，
           the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes     則於資產或負債的最有利市場進行。主要
           place either in the principal market for the asset or liability,      或最有利市場須位於本集團能到達的地方。
           or in the absence of a principal market, in the most                  資產或負債的公允值乃基於市場參與者為
           advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal         資產或負債定價所用的假設計量（假設市場
           or the most advantageous market must be accessible by                 參與者依照彼等的最佳經濟利益行事）。
           the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is
           measured using the assumptions that market participants
           would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that
           market participants act in their economic best interest.

           A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into          以公允值計量非金融資產，應當考慮市場
           account a market participant’s ability to generate economic           參與者將該資產用於最佳用途產生經濟利
           benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by         益的能力，或者將該資產出售予能夠用於
           selling it to another market participant that would use the           最佳用途的其他市場參與者產生經濟利益
           asset in its highest and best use.                                    的能力。

           The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in           本集團以公允值計量相關資產或負債，應
           the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available         當採用在當前情況下適用，並且有足夠可
           to measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant                 利用資料的估值技術，以及盡量使用相關
           observable inputs and minimising the use of unobservable              可觀察輸入資料，盡量避免使用不可觀察
           inputs.                                                               輸入資料。

           Impairment of financial assets                                      金融資產減值
           The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit               本集團就所有並非按公允值計入損益持有
           losses (“ECLs”) for all debt instruments not held at fair value     的債務工具確認預期信貸虧損（「預期信貸
           through profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference            虧損」）。預期信貸虧損乃以根據合約應付
           between the contractual cash flows due in accordance with           的合約現金流量與本集團預期收取的所有
           the contract and all the cash flows that the Group expects          現金流量之間的差額為基準，按原有實際
           to receive, discounted at an approximation of the original          利率相近的差額貼現。預期現金流量將包
           effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will include       括來自銷售所持有抵押品或其他信用增級
           cash flows from the sale of collateral held or other credit         的現金流量，此乃合約條款不可或缺的部
           enhancements that are integral to the contractual terms.            分。

           General approach                                                    一般方法
           ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures             預期信貸虧損於兩個階段進行確認。對於
           for which there has not been a significant increase in credit       自初始確認後並無顯著增加的信貸風險，

           historical default rates are adjusted. At each reporting date,         比率均會更新，並分析前瞻性估計的變動。
           the historical observed default rates are updated and

49. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                        49. 財務風險管理目標及政策
    OBJECTIVES AND POLICIES
   Financial risk management                                           財務風險管理
   The Group’s principal financial instruments, other than             本集團的主要金融工具（衍生工具除外）包
   derivatives, comprise cash and cash equivalents, time               括現金及現金等價物、定期存款、保證金存
   deposits, pledged deposits, trade and bills receivables and         款、應收及應付賬款及票據、其他應收及應
   payables, other receivables and payables, long term                 付款項、與關聯人士的長期應收結餘、委託
   receivables balances with related parties, entrusted loans,         貸款、計息銀行及其他借貸、可換股債券及
   interest-bearing bank and other borrowings, convertible             其他金融負債。該等金融工具旨在為本集
   bonds and other financial liabilities. The main purpose of          團的營運籌集資金。本集團擁有各式各樣
   these financial instruments is to raise finance for the             直接來自其業務的其他金融資產及負債，
   Group’s operations. The Group has various other financial           例如應收賬款及應付賬款。
   assets and liabilities such as trade receivables and trade
   payables, which arise directly from its operations.

   The Group also entered into derivative transactions, mainly         本集團亦訂立衍生交易，主要為利率互換
   interest rate swaps, currency forward swaps and currency            合約、外幣遠期互換合約及遠期外幣合約，
